audience: course creators and coaches who sell memberships on a Kourses website

useCases.title: See which memberships a website sells
useCases.text: List the published memberships of your Kourses website. Each one has an id, a name, a slug and a URL.

useCases.title: Check what a member can access right now
useCases.text: Look up a member by id or email and list the memberships they can access today. Expired permissions are not shown.

useCases.title: Add a new buyer as a member
useCases.text: Create a member from the details of a new buyer. If the email already exists, the given fields overwrite the stored ones.

useCases.title: Give a member access to a membership
useCases.text: Grant a member access to a membership, optionally until a set date. The member gets an email only when you ask for one.

useCases.title: Remove a member's access to a membership
useCases.text: Revoke a member's access to a membership now, or on a set end date. The member loses access to that content.
